title: Possessives 4: This and That (этот / тот)
description: Demonstrative pronouns этот, эта, это, эти ('this / these') and тот, та, то, те ('that / those') agree with the noun, like мой and наш. Today we drill the four forms of each.
descriptionRussian: Указательные местоимения 'этот / эта / это / эти' (this / these) и 'тот / та / то / те' (that / those) согласуются с существительным, как 'мой' и 'наш'. Сегодня — четыре формы каждого ряда.
intro: Third time through the same four slots, which by now you should be able to predict before you are told. That is worth pausing on: the endings in this lesson are less new information than confirmation that Russian is regular where it counts. What is genuinely new is what these words let you do. Pointing at something and naming it is how most beginners get through their first real conversation, and this is the lesson that makes it possible.
rules: Этот / эта / это / эти ('this' / 'these') agrees with the noun: -∅ for masculine (just этот), -а for feminine, -о for neuter, -и for plural.
Тот / та / то / те ('that' / 'those') is the parallel set: same four-slot pattern with the consonant т-: тот, та, то, те.

Both demonstrative series collapse gender in the plural. Эти (этот series, ending -и) and те (тот series, ending -е) each cover all three genders, the same way adjectives and possessives collapse gender in the plural.

The neuter demonstrative это has the same shape as the existential это ('this is...'), but the existential does not agree with anything. Distinguish them by the role: demonstrative + noun + adjective vs existential + noun.
Demonstratives go before the noun in unmarked word order: эта книга, тот парк, эти дети.
examples: Этот дом старый. (This house is old.) Дом is masculine singular, so the demonstrative is этот.
Эта книга интересная. (This book is interesting.) Книга is feminine singular, so the demonstrative takes -а: эта.
Это окно большое. (This window is big.) Окно is neuter singular, so the demonstrative takes -о: это.
Эти дома новые. (These houses are new.) Дома is plural, so the demonstrative takes -и: эти. The plural ending is the same regardless of gender.
Тот парк красивый. (That park is beautiful.) Парк is masculine singular, so the тот series gives тот.
Те дети маленькие. (Those children are small.) Дети is plural, so the тот series takes -е: те.

items.promptEnglish: Recap from Lesson 3: this is Masha. This is her book.
items.hint: The owner is female ('her'). The form does not agree with feminine книга.
items.explanation: Recap from Lesson 3. Книга is feminine, but the OWNER is 'her', so the form is её. The trio его / её / их never changes form; today's lesson returns to demonstratives, which DO agree.

items.hint: Дом is masculine singular. Pick the masculine form of the этот series.
items.explanation: Дом is masculine singular. The masculine form of the этот series is just этот. Note that the sentence has a separate predicate adjective (старый), which marks this as a demonstrative use, not an existential.

items.hint: Улица ends in -а. Which form takes -а on the demonstrative?
items.explanation: Улица is feminine singular. The feminine form of the этот series is эта. Pair this with красивая (also feminine -ая) and notice that the agreement of the demonstrative and the adjective travels together.

items.hint: Озеро ends in -о. Which form fits the neuter slot of the этот series?
items.explanation: Озеро is neuter singular. The neuter form of the этот series is это. The same form also serves as the existential ('Это озеро' = 'This is a lake'); today's sentence is demonstrative because it carries a predicate adjective (большое).

items.hint: Дети is plural. Match the plural ending across all genders.
items.explanation: Дети is plural. The plural form of the этот series is эти. The same -и ending sits on every plural noun: эти дома, эти книги, эти окна.

items.hint: Парк is masculine singular. Use today's second series, the 'that' series.
items.explanation: Парк is masculine singular. The masculine form of the тот series is тот. Use the тот series when the thing is farther from the speaker or in contrast with a closer этот: 'Этот дом старый, а тот дом новый.'

fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Машина is feminine singular. The feminine form of the тот series is та.

sentenceBuilding.hint: Учитель is masculine singular (the soft -ь does not change the gender). Use the masculine form of the тот series.
Квартира is feminine singular. The demonstrative and the adjective both take feminine endings.
Дети is plural. Match the plural ending on both the demonstrative and the adjective.

minimalPairs.explanation: Дом is masculine singular, so the demonstrative is этот. Эта would only fit a feminine noun like улица.
Окна is plural (the plural of окно). The plural form of the этот series is эти. The neuter singular это would fit окно in the singular: 'Это окно большое.'

reviewVocab.definition: demonstrative pronoun (a word like этот, эта, это, эти, тот, та, то, те that points to a specific thing)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Этот дом старый' слово 'этот' — указательное местоимение в мужском роде.

reviewVocab.definition: near deixis (the этот series, used for things close to the speaker or recently mentioned)
reviewVocab.example: Когда вещь рядом со мной, я использую ближний дейксис: 'Эта книга на моём столе.'

reviewVocab.definition: copula (the implicit 'is' in Russian existential sentences like 'Это книга'; in present tense Russian leaves it unwritten)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Это книга' связка не пишется, но подразумевается. Это отличает существование от указания.
